description: This PHP class 'AttendanceRecordAPI' is part of a Human Resource Management system. It provides REST API endpoints for managing attendance records, including retrieving and updating attendance data, with validation and permission checks.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordAPI
classes.description: A REST API class for managing attendance records, including retrieving and updating punch-in/out times with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attendance record by ID, performs permission checks, and returns detailed data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a specific attendance record with new punch-in/out data, with overlap validation and timezone handling.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.name: setAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Sets or updates punch-in/out times and notes for an attendance record, with overlap and timezone validation.

methods.name: getRequestBodyParams
methods.description: Extracts punch-in/out parameters from the request body.

methods.name: extractPunchDateTime
methods.description: Creates a DateTime object from date and time strings with timezone offset.

methods.name: isAllowedToEditTimezone
methods.description: Checks if the user is permitted to edit timezone data based on provided offset and name.
